rules.svg: Canonical vector master exported with Figma SVG_STRING
rules.raster: Rendered directly at runtime from the SVG master via expo-image (KodjoIcon.tsx), density-independent — no separate 1x/2x/3x PNG pipeline exists or is required
rules.substitution: Typography characters and approximate icons are forbidden
rules.systemStatusBar: Rendered by iOS or Android; not bundled as application assets
rules.figmaStatus: EXACT_EXPORT = file content equals the current Figma SVG export (line endings aside); EQUIVALENT_GEOMETRY = same drawing, Figma encodes the path differently; SOURCE_EXISTS = node read in Figma on 2026-10-07, repository drawing kept unchanged (navigation icons: brief E.6); SOURCE_REMOVED = historical node absent from Figma and no current equivalent verified, figmaNodeId is null and historicalFigmaNodeId keeps the trace; MCP_VECTOR_EXPORT = vector layer served by the read-only Figma MCP download_assets tool (svgAssets); geometry and fill unchanged, root attributes preserveAspectRatio/overflow/style removed and a double-encoded group id repaired, line endings aside
